questions.question: Why should you buy your domain name before filing your LLC paperwork?
questions.questionHtml: Why should you buy your domain name before filing your LLC paperwork?

answers.text: Domain names are more expensive after you register an LLC
answers.textHtml: Domain names are more expensive after you register an LLC

answers.text: To prevent someone else from claiming your business name online while you complete paperwork
answers.textHtml: To prevent someone else from claiming your business name online while you complete paperwork

answers.text: The LLC requires a domain name on the application
answers.textHtml: The LLC requires a domain name on the application

answers.text: Registrars offer discounts to new businesses
answers.textHtml: Registrars offer discounts to new businesses

questions.feedback: Securing your domain and social media accounts before filing paperwork prevents others from claiming your chosen business name online during the registration process.
questions.feedbackHtml: Secure your digital presence first to prevent others from claiming your business name online.

answers.textHtml: To get the review removed

answers.text: Because future customers will judge you by how you handle criticism
